title: ‘That sound follows me’: Survivors recall 'horrific' US strike on Iranian wedding
content: the explosion came during a US bombardment of southern Iran . four people were killed at the scene, while a fifth victim, a 22-year-old woman critically wounded, died in hospital two days later . at least 60 people were wounded in the blast .

title: One dead and 11 missing after landslide hits China’s Jiangxi
content: more than 10 buried as landslide hits china's Jiangxi province . one person dead and 11 others missing . the incident comes as china grapples with severe weather . Typhoon Saudel-triggered floods inundated homes and swept through tea-growing communities .

title: Three children dead and a mistrial: What is the Lindsay Clancy case?
content: the trial ended in a mistrial on friday after jurors failed to reach a verdict following seven days of deliberations . the dramatic conclusion came after a five-week trial focused largely on one question: was Clancy criminally responsible for the deaths or was she suffering from severe mental illness at the time?

title: Bangladesh measles outbreak nears 1,000 child deaths as cases cross 180,000
content: more than 1,000 suspected cases are being reported each day . 101 children are currently admitted with suspected or confirmed measles . at least 986 children have died since march, according to the health ministry . a nine-month-old son is among the children being treated at the hospital .

title: 'Bound to breed contempt for law': SC judge on police action at Jantar Mantar protest
content: justice ujjal Bhuyan criticizes police officers over alleged assault on protesters . he says police must maintain credibility because people seek their help when they feel wronged . the detachment expected of police officers appears to be disappearing .

title: Razing of illegal mosque sparks row in UP's Saharanpur, SP MP put under house arrest
content: authorities demolish a mosque inside the district magistrate's office complex in saharanpur . a court upheld an earlier order declaring the structure illegal . the collectorate complex was placed under heavy security .

title: 'Trump furious about leaks': US orders polygraph test for top officials
content: the investigation centred on leaks about dwindling US stocks of advanced weapons . the tests sought to determine whether military officers and civilian employees had disclosed classified information to journalists . several dozen people had also been tested earlier in the summer, including officials at US central Command and other combatant commands .

title: UN declares Nov 27 as ‘International Day For Elimination Of Child Marriage’
content: the u.n. has declared November 27 the international day for the elimination of child, early and forced marriage . the date carries special significance for India, which backed the resolution steered by Sierra Leone .

title: Enough for 9 days: Coal stock at thermal plants plummets, 'critical' at 50 units
content: 50 plants classified as having 'critically low' inventories as on sept 2 . the plants, with a combined capacity of around 224 GW, had 28.2 million tonnes of coal as of Wednesday, 48% of the prescribed requirement of 58.7 MT .

title: Southern Sweden’s wetland revival aims to support 100 breeding pairs of white storks
content: white storks once formed a familiar part of the landscape in southern Sweden . by 1954 the species had disappeared as a breeding bird from the country . their decline was closely linked to dramatic changes in the countryside, where wetlands were drained and other habitats altered over generations .
